def evaluate_guess(guess, answer):
    marks = ["-"] * 5
    counts = Counter(answer)
    for i in range(5):
        if guess[i] == answer[i]:
            marks[i] = "G"
            counts[guess[i]] -= 1
    for i in range(5):
        if marks[i] != "G" and counts[guess[i]] > 0:
            marks[i] = "Y"
            counts[guess[i]] -= 1
    return marks

def tile(letter, mark):
    return f"{MARK_BG[mark]}{BOLD} {letter.upper()} {RESET}"

def render_board(history):
    lines = []
    for guess, marks in history:
        lines.append(" ".join(tile(guess[i], marks[i]) for i in range(5)))
    return "\n".join(lines)

def pick_word(words, daily=True):
    if daily:
        import datetime
        return words[datetime.date.today().toordinal() % len(words)]
    import random
    return random.choice(words)
